নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.question: ১) Which is the shortest period of English literature?
নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.exp:
English Literature Periods:
450 - 1066 :- The Old English Period
1066 - 1500 :- The Middle English Period
1500 - 1660 :- The Renaissance Period
1660 - 1785 :- The Neoclassical Period
1798 - 1832 :- Romantic Period
1832 - 1901 :- Victorian Period

The Neo-classical Period is divided into three shorter periods:
• The Restoration Period (1660-1700),
• The Augustan Period (1700-1745) and
• The Age of Sensibility (1745-1785/1798).

Among them Romantic Period is the shortest period of English literature. 

Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

The Modern Period (1901-1939):
The period between 1901 and 1939 is generally accepted as the ‘Modern Period’ of English literature.
Queen Victoria's death in 1901 marks the beginning of this new literary era and the beginning of the Second World War in 1939 indicates its end.
The Modern Period comprises two shorter ages-
(a) The Edwardian Period (1901-1910)
(b) The Georgian Period (1911-1936)

“For God’s sake, hold your tongue and let me love” This line occurs in John Donne’s famous poem ‘The Canonization’.

"For God's sake hold your tongue, and let me love,
Or chide my palsy, or my gout,
My five gray hairs, or ruined fortune flout,
With wealth your state, your mind with arts improve,
Take you a course, get you a place,
Observe his honor, or his grace,
Or the king's real, or his stampèd face
Contemplate; what you will, approve,
So you will let me love." 

Source: The Canonization; by John Donne

নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.question: ৩১) Pun occurs when single word conveys_____ meaning.

Pun or Paronomasia:
A play upon words which are similar in sound but different in meaning.

নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.question: ৩৩) Who is not the poet of Modern Period?
নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.exp:
The Modern Period (1901-1939):
The period between 1901 and 1939 is generally accepted as the ‘Modern Period’ of English literature.
Queen Victoria's death in 1901 marks the beginning of this new literary era and the beginning of the Second World War in 1939 indicates its end.
The Modern Period comprises two shorter ages-
(a) The Edwardian Period (1901-1910)
(b) The Georgian Period (1911-1936)
Rudyard Kipling , Virginia Woolf and Burtrand Russell belongs to the Modern Period.

Robert Browning is a Victorian Poet.
His major works are: Dramatic Lyrics, Men and Women, Dramatis Personae.

Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.question: ৩৯) In Which two Contradictory words are put together?
নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.exp:
Oxymoron:
A figure of speech in which apparently contradictory words are put together.
When we use phrases like male-female, host-guest, civil war, open secret, magic realism or wise fool, we, in fact, use oxymorons.

Here is a famous example:
All changed, changed utterly:
A terrible beauty is born.
(Yeats: ''Easter 1916'')

Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman.

নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.exp:
- These lines are taken from Christopher Marlowe's Drama 'Doctor Faustus'.
These lines come from a speech that Faustus makes as he nears the end of his life and begins to realize the terrible nature of the bargain he has made. Despite his sense of foreboding, Faustus enjoys his powers, as the delight he takes in conjuring up Helen makes clear.

Some other important quotes from Christopher Marlowe:
- Man is the maker of his own fate.
- There is no sin but ignorance.
- Pluck up your hearts, since fate still rests our friend.

নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.question: ৪১) ‘Anonymous’ writings was one of the main features of which age?
নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.exp:
The Old English Period / The Anglo-Saxon Period (450-1066):

Main Literary Features of the Age:
- Most of the literary works are anonymous.
- Strong belief in Fate is reflected.
- Romantic love is absent.
- Attitude to women is respectful.
- In the Anglo-Saxon Period evil is symbolized by monsters.

Source: An ABC of English Literature - Dr M Mofizar Rahman

নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.exp:
'Sons and Lovers', semiautobiographical novel by D.H. Lawrence, published in 1913.
- His first mature novel, it is a psychological study of the familial and love relationships of a working-class English family.

The novel revolves around Paul Morel, a sensitive young artist whose love for his mother, Gertrude, overshadows his romances with two women: Miriam Leivers, his repressed, religious girlfriend, and Clara Dawes, an experienced, independent married woman. Unable to watch his mother die slowly of cancer, Paul kills her with morphine. Despite losing her and rejecting both Miriam and Clara, Paul harbours hope for the future.

Source: Britannica.

Example, “Ten thousand saw I at a glance” 
                (Wordsworth:"Daffodils")

- It is used to create strong emotional responses.
- It can be positive as well as negative.
- It can be source of laughter.
- It can also be a bitter criticism.

নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.option1: ক) Poetry serves as the main genre.

নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.option3: গ) The writers are influenced by Dante, Petrarch and Boccaccio.
নতুনদের বিসিএস প্রস্তুতি (১৫০ দিনে পুরো.exp:
Main Literary Features of The Middle English Period (1066-1500):
- Poetry serves as the main genre.
- Prose in English gets a strong foundation.
- The English language reaches a considerable standard though old spelling continues.
- Drama began in the form of ''Mystery Play,'' ''Morality Play'' and ''Interlude''.
- The writers of the age are influenced by Dante, Petrarch and Boccaccio.
- Love, chivalry and religion are the three main literary subjects of this period.

Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.
